"contents: write" is set at the workflow level: it lets the job push commits and tags and create or delete releases, and a job added later inherits it silently. set "permissions: {}" at the workflow level and grant "contents: write" on the job

"pull-requests: write" is set at the workflow level: it lets the job create and modify pull requests, comments and reviews, and a job added later inherits it silently. set "permissions: {}" at the workflow level and grant "pull-requests: write" on the job

workflow has no "concurrency:", so every run of it executes at the same time even when a newer run is started while one is running (job "deploy" uses "cloudflare/wrangler-action"). add a top-level "concurrency:" with a "group:" and "cancel-in-progress: false", so that a new run waits for the running release or deployment to finish instead of cancelling it. a newer run that is waiting replaces an older one that is waiting, so add "queue: max" when no release may be skipped

"npm publish" publishes to npm with the long-lived credential NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, although the job can request an OIDC token ("id-token: write"). prefer trusted publishing: configure the trusted publisher of the package on npmjs.com and grant the permission "id-token: write", then no token is needed
